findings.text: Station Controllers to replace expired portable extinguishers and certify to the Safety Department
findings.quote: Every Station Controller shall replace all expired portable extinguishers and certify the replacement to the Safety Department on or before 21 August 2026.

findings.text: Inspect portable extinguishers at all elevated stations and certify to the Safety Department
findings.textEn: Portable fire extinguishers at all elevated stations must be inspected before 21 August 2026 and a certificate given to the Safety Department.
findings.quote: എല്ലാ എലിവേറ്റഡ് സ്റ്റേഷനുകളിലെയും പോർട്ടബിൾ അഗ്നിശമന ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ 2026 ഓഗസ്റ്റ് 21-ന് മുമ്പ് പരിശോധിച്ച് സാക്ഷ്യപത്രം സഹിതം സുരക്ഷാ വിഭാഗത്തിന് നൽകണം.

findings.text: Operations Control Centre to complete pending evacuation drills and report
findings.quote: The Operations Control Centre must complete the pending drills and report to the Chief Safety Officer not later than 31 August 2026.
